title: The Kapoors Begin a Wedding the Quiet Way. Anshula Kapoor's Pre-Wedding Lit Up With Gold, Phulkari, and the Whole Clan in One Frame.
excerpt: Arjun, Janhvi, Khushi and Shanaya gathered for a Mata Ki Chowki as Boney Kapoor's daughter kicks off a July wedding — and the 1:15 AM love story behind it is melting the internet.
body:
The Kapoors don't do quiet. So when the family that gave Hindi cinema its most photographed faces decided to begin a wedding with prayer instead of a party, it said something. On Sunday evening in Mumbai, under an idol of Goddess Durga and a canopy of flowers, **Anshula Kapoor** and **Rohan Thakkar** lit the first lamp of their wedding — a Mata Ki Chowki, hosted by aunt **Maheep Kapoor**, that traded the usual flashbulb chaos for aarti, soulful music, and the whole clan in one room.

And what a room it was.

> "Shaadi begins. Jai Mata Di, Anshula and Rohan." — Maheep Kapoor


![Goddess Durga — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/65/Mahishasura-Mardini_Durga.jpg)


https://x.com/IndiaToday/status/2068881405317447932

That single Instagram caption set the internet alight. Within hours, the feed was a swirl of zardozi and kundan: **Arjun Kapoor** beaming beside the sister he's fiercely protected his whole life, **Janhvi Kapoor** floating through the frames in a soft pink saree, **Khushi Kapoor** in a designer sharara, **Shanaya Kapoor** posting "We love you Anshula and Rohan." Sanjay and Maheep Kapoor turned playful photobombers. Sunita Kapoor presided as the family's senior-most woman. It was less a function than a portrait of a dynasty that has weathered more than its share of grief, gathered to celebrate one of its own.



> **"It was less a function than a portrait of a dynasty that has weathered more than its share of grief, gathered to celebrate one of its own."**


## The bride who built her own spotlight


![Mata Ki Chowki — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/2/26/MataKiChowki2.jpg)


Make no mistake about who the night belonged to. Anshula — daughter of producer **Boney Kapoor** and the late **Mona Shourie Kapoor** — has never chased the camera the way her famous siblings do, and yet on Sunday she was its undisputed centre. She wore a heavily embroidered beige-and-gold lehenga alive with crystal work and hand embroidery, then did the most Punjabi thing imaginable: she draped a vivid Phulkari dupatta over one shoulder, letting tradition cut through all that couture. A layered kundan necklace, a maang tikka, a sleek bun pinned with gold — soft glam, no theatrics. She looked, in a word, radiant.

Rohan matched her note for note in understated ethnic wear, the kind of groom who knows the evening isn't about him and dresses accordingly. The two performed the holy aarti together, heads bowed, before the puja dissolved into exactly the scene you'd hope for — family on the dance floor, the elders laughing, the next generation filming everything.

## A love story written at 1:15 AM


![Mumbai — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2b/Mumbai_Bandra-Worli_Sea_Link.jpg)


Here's the detail that's melting the timeline. Anshula and Rohan met in 2022 — on a dating app, of all places — and their very first conversation began at 1:15 AM on a Tuesday and ran for hours. Three years later, Rohan proposed in New York's Central Park, in front of the castle, at exactly 1:15 AM. He brought the clock back to where it started. If a screenwriter pitched that, you'd call it too neat. Real life, it turns out, is the better writer.

The couple got engaged last year and announced it with a joint post that drew a flood of love. Sunday's Mata Ki Chowki was the formal opening act of a celebration that, per industry reports, builds toward the main wedding rituals on July 4, 5, and 6, with a reception at Taj Lands End in Mumbai. Filmmaker **Zoya Akhtar**, **Farah Khan**, and **Bhavana Pandey** were among those showering the couple with affection online.


## The diaspora angle

For NRI readers, this one lands close to home — quite literally. Rohan proposed in Manhattan, and the couple's romance has unfolded across continents, the kind of long-haul, time-zone-juggling love that diaspora families know intimately. Expect the festivities to play out in real time on the Kapoors' Instagram grids, which means fans in the US, UK, and Canada can follow every outfit, every ritual, every teary toast without missing the IST clock. No streaming subscription required — just a follow button and a soft spot for a good shaadi.

A few notable absences stirred chatter: Sonam Kapoor, Harshvardhan, and Rhea Kapoor sat this one out, though Sunita Kapoor stepped in to perform the elder's rituals. But the headline image is the one that matters — a family that has known loss, standing shoulder to shoulder in gold and grinning.

## What's next

Two weeks of celebrations stretch ahead, culminating in the July wedding. If Sunday was the soft, sacred prologue, the Kapoors are not the type to keep it low-key for long. Somewhere between now and July 6, the sangeet choreography is being rehearsed, the designer racks are filling up, and at least one viral dance reel is being born. Watch this space. The internet certainly will.
